detail.longDescription: I'm trying to convert an adjacency list to a matrix but I get array of 0. This is my code: function adjacencyListToMatrix(adjacencyList) { const nodes = Object.keys(adjacencyList) const n = nodes.length; const matrix = Array.from({ length: n }, () => Array(n).fill(0)); for (let i=0; i < n; i++) { for (let j=i+1; j < n; j++) { adjacencyList[i][j] = 1; } } return matrix; }; console.log(adjacencyListToMatrix({0: [2], 1: [2, 3], 2: [0, 1, 3], 3: [1, 2]})); How can I do it ?
